text: Precise source: Utf8Lenient has only one production caller, TableDigest.ofUtf8. The extra full byte buffer is needed only to feed SHA-256; existing Sha256Core.Hasher already supports incremental bytes. Replace that buffered route with the same historical UTF-8 byte emission into the incremental hasher, including its deliberately retained lone-surrogate convention. This avoids changing export formats or imposing a new table size cap. Completed native d63 canonical gate and all hosted workflows are preserved; new export successor gets its own qualification.
